logp.method_description: Lipophilicity was determined according to the previous literature (13). n-Octanol (saturated withsodium chloride) was mixed with an equal volume of saline solution. Each platinum(II) complexwas dissolved into the mixture at 20 μM and further shaken in the mixture for 1 h at 1000 × g.Samples were centrifuged to separate into two layers, withdrawn from each phase (10 μL) anddigested with 68% nitric acid (290 μL) at 70°C overnight. The platinum content of each complex ineach phase was determined by measuring the platinum content (μg/L) using ICP-MS. The log Pvalue for each complex was determined as the logarithmic ratio of the concentrations of theplatinum level in n-octanol to aqueous phases.
